question: Does fitting the abstention gate to reject every observed foreign training link preserve useful correct links in the complete tracker?
change: Only the empirical gate calibration and system selection change. Native confirmation, sole-of-two geometry, common support, alpha0.2, native aliases and collision refusal stay identical. No core/model/detector/image or geometry reconstruction. All existing maps, sparse labels, native traces and equivalent policy outcomes reused.

calibration.rule: On fit20 only, first exclude candidate policies with any observed foreign accepted link; among the rest maximize known correct links, then smaller cap, then GEOMETRY,IMAGE,R1,DIS,FLYVIS. Unknown links are neither negatives nor positives. Off/cap0 always available; if no correct link remains, stop.

controls: All main image/motion/FlyVis/geometry variants use the selected same cap. Also include independently fitted pure-geometry AGE_FIT and previously fixed AGE6. RANDOM_MATCHED and PERM_MATCHED use label-free fit-only cutoffs matching the selected gate acceptance rate before aliases; no future-frame top-k choice. Undefined scores always abstain.
gate: After fit-only selection is sealed, evaluate the same historical26. Proceed only if the selected system or AGE_FIT has positive lower95%paired-video CI for known correct-minus-foreign links and no observed foreign links on26. This is a development gate, not proof of zero population error.
full_acceptance: Exact native physical outputs. Positive corrected pooledHOTA lowerCI versusB0, nonnegative meanAssA/IDF1, nonincreasing IDSw/FP/FN/known wrong returns, more correct and sustained old-ID returns. FlyVis contribution additionally must beat every matched control. Do not weaken a failed guard.
strongest_alternative: The apparent improvement can come from recency, reduced intervention frequency or another development pass on already studied data. Same-cap geometry, AGE_FIT, AGE6, matched-frequency random and spatial-permutation controls distinguish these explanations.
limitation: The previous26result has already been inspected and motivated this change. This is explicitly exploratory development on reused data, not a fresh independent confirmation. Only23known fit candidate edges, including7foreign, are available; zero empirical error is not a probability guarantee. The current T4/T5 readout limitation remains unchanged.

literature.title: Selective Classification for Deep Neural Networks
literature.used: Risk-versus-coverage framing and the explicit warning that controlling training error alone does not guarantee test risk. We do not implement or claim the paper's guaranteed-risk procedure.
